Privacy

Your dates stay here

NextDue stores your profile and dates in this browser. This release has no account, backend, analytics, or advertising trackers.

  • We do not ask for passport numbers, tax IDs, addresses, or scans.
  • Browser storage is convenient, not guaranteed encrypted. Avoid shared devices.
  • Download a JSON backup before clearing browser data or changing devices.

Calendar files leave the app only when you download or open them.

External hosting

OAuth-ready SaaS path

The external package is designed for a custom domain and portable Docker hosting:

  • Next.js on the Node runtime
  • Auth.js with Google and configurable OIDC
  • PostgreSQL with account-level isolation
  • Separate consent for Google or Microsoft Calendar
  • Background reminder worker and audit trail

OAuth credentials, production domain, database, and legal review are required before a live public launch.
